description:
After starting a garage band, Marionette, Rarity, Fluttershy and Starlight Glimmer are personally invited by Princess Celestia to play music aboard her own Cruise Ship, the S.S. Celestia, during it's weekend voyage across the Atlantic. Over the course of the trip, Marionette slowly unearths the tragic story of her mother and father...

If you like what I do people consider joining my Patreon! It's the best way to help support what I do! 
https://www.patreon.com/Tamers12345
